g.title: MinVelRank6Convo1 begins.
g.text: MinVelRank6Convo1 begins.

g.title: j924880037
g.text: MomToxicated: You know, I think I'm actually going to like it here.

g.title: j2878882208
g.text: Even if we never get answers about Rusalka?

g.title: j259581991
g.text: Really? Why's that?

g.title: j734064178
g.text: Check boolean MinVelTogether

g.title: j3877146322
g.text: MomToxicated: It's nice to have like-minded individuals around to talk to.

g.title: j1531960586
g.text: MomToxicated: I think you'll get the answers you need, in the end.

g.title: j734064178->j1531960586
g.text: true

g.title: j4248976121
g.text: MomToxicated: Not every story has a happy ending, Drifter.

g.title: j734064178->j4248976121
g.text: false

g.title: j3975615429
g.text: MomToxicated: The ladies here are quite something.

g.title: j3451406070
g.text: MomToxicated: And I can be at peace with that.

g.title: j1538735836
g.text: MomToxicated: And sometimes, that's okay.

g.title: j3098159928
g.text: MomToxicated: We're starting a book club.

g.title: j1022332361
g.text: MomToxicated: I just hope that... whatever she's become, whatever she really is -

g.title: j375814019
g.text: MomToxicated: Without tears, we wouldn't know how to laugh.

g.title: j1528553414
g.text: MomToxicated: But even if we never get the answers we're looking for about Neci?

g.title: j248222522
g.text: MomToxicated: Some part of her is still our little girl.

g.title: j575993901
g.text: MomToxicated: Without death, life would have no meaning.

g.title: j2997139260
g.text: MomToxicated: And that part, however small it might be, finds her own peace.

g.title: j2126196103
g.text: MomToxicated: And without a yesterday, we wouldn't appreciate a new tomorrow.

g.title: j4171201458
g.text: PapaPolar: we raised her to be the best parts of both of us. tough. vicious. kind. resourceful.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j621964421
g.text: PapaPolar: but above all, she's a sols-damned *survivor*

g.title: j2826338426
g.text: PapaPolar: so when you do cross paths with whatever is wearing her face next?

g.title: j2057787660
g.text: PapaPolar: you tell her this, from us:

g.title: j236235497
g.text: Boolean VelimirEclipse is now true.

g.title: j2009493405
g.text: PapaPolar: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse."

g.title: j3528648867
g.text: Um. Okay. Noted.

g.title: j3403120573
g.text: What's... that supposed to mean?

g.title: j130123446
g.text: MomToxicated: Also... thank you. For helping us remember why we really came here.

g.title: j3526327544
g.text: MomToxicated: We'd tell you, but then we'd have to kill you. ;)

g.title: j724883598
g.text: MomToxicated: It was about finding something we'd lost, deep down.

g.title: j3865597528
g.text: MomToxicated: Not just Neci.

g.title: j2389774262
g.text: PapaPolar: but also each other.

g.title: j2277440286
g.text: PapaPolar: seriously. i never thought of myself as the retiring type.

g.title: j3321959584
g.text: PapaPolar: but here? with these lovable idiots?

g.title: j1488832886
g.text: PapaPolar: and my beautiful, *incredibly* sexy wife? hard to not be happy.

g.title: j2704207246
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah... neci's a grown woman. but whatever she is, whatever answers are out there...

g.title: j2998913455
g.text: PapaPolar: i think our part in that story ends here, lil buddy.

g.title: j1712345049
g.text: PapaPolar: and that's fine by us.

g.title: j3916360928
g.text: PapaPolar: you got this.

g.title: j4067964943
g.text: Boolean MinervaVelimirBar is now true.
